preamble: The voiceless retroflex fricative [ʂ] becomes voiced [ʐ] before a voiced obstruent through regressive voicing assimilation. Russian obstruent clusters agree in voicing with their final obstruent, inside words and across word boundaries when there is no pause, so the hard sibilant ш /ʂ/ surfaces as [ʐ] before voiced stops, as in лишь бы [ˈlʲiʐ‿bɨ] and Ашгабат [ɐʐɡɐˈbat].

examples.note: ш assimilates in voicing to the following б across the clitic boundary

context: Before a voiced obstruent, including across word boundaries without a pause
